description.description: The element radius description. Max limit = 256.

name.description: The name of the radius server.

override_indicator.description: The override indicator. Certain configurations can be overridden from RADIUS server using the user policy.

radius_configuration.description: The details of the radius configuration parameters.

accounting_port.description: The radius configuration accounting port number between 1-65535. Default port is 1813.

authentication_port.description: The radius configuration authentication port number between 1-65535. Default port is 1812.

priority.description: The priority value between 1-255. Lower the priority number, higher is the priority.

retain_shared_secret.description: If the shared secret is retained. Value = True/False.

shared_secret.description: The shared secret, the length of the secret must be between 8-64 characters.

shared_secret_encrypted.description: The encrypted shared secret. Value = True.

source_interface_id.description: The source interface ID of the selected port.

tags.description: A information field that can be added to identify the radius server. Maximum 10 unique tags of length 128 each are allowed.
